SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM orders;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM customers;

SELECT 
    order_status, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM 
    orders
GROUP BY 
    order_status;

SELECT 
  SUM(order_items.price) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  orders
  JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE 
  orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
  orders
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
  month;

SELECT 
    p.product_category_name,
    t.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE 
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    p.product_category_name,
    t.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY 
    ciro DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp))::numeric::decimal AS ortalama_teslim_suresi
FROM 
  orders
WHERE 
  order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS perc_delivered_late
FROM 
  orders
JOIN 
  order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE 
  orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
    customers.customer_state, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM 
    customers

    customers.customer_state

SELECT

    SUM(order_payments.payment_value) AS total_paid

    orders ON order_payments.order_id = orders.order_id

    order_payments.payment_type;

FROM 
    orders o
JOIN

    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

    o.order_status = 'delivered'

    c.customer_state

SELECT 
    sellers.seller_id,
    SUM(order_items.price) AS ciro
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
JOIN 
    sellers ON order_items.seller_id = sellers.seller_id
WHERE 
    orders.order_status = 'delivered'

    sellers.seller_id

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS mesafe_ay,
  SUM(order_items.price) AS aylık_ciro
FROM 
  orders
JOIN 
  order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id

  order_purchase_timestamp BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-03-31'
  AND orders.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)

  mesafe_ay;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS day_of_week,
    COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
    orders
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
    order_count DESC;

SELECT

    AVG(or.review_score) AS ortalama_puan
FROM 
    order_reviews or

    orders o ON or.order_id = o.order_id

    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_unique_id) AS tekrar_eden_musteri
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY customers.customer_unique_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) >= 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_unique_id)
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
WHERE orders.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND orders.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
  AND customers.customer_unique_id NOT IN (
    SELECT customer_unique_id
    FROM customers
    WHERE customer_unique_id IN (
      SELECT customer_unique_id
      FROM customers
      JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
      WHERE orders.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
        AND orders.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
      GROUP BY customer_unique_id
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) > 1
    )
  );

SELECT 
    order_id, 
    COUNT(order_item_id) AS kalem_sayisi
FROM 
    order_items
GROUP BY 
    order_id;

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN total_order_value > avg_order_value THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_above_avg
FROM (
  SELECT 
    orders.order_id,
    SUM(order_items.price + order_items.freight_value) AS total_order_value
  FROM 
    orders
  JOIN 
    order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
  WHERE 
    orders.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY 
    orders.order_id
) AS order_values
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(total_order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      SUM(order_items.price + order_items.freight_value) AS total_order_value
    FROM 
      orders
    JOIN 
      order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
    WHERE 
      orders.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY 
      orders.order_id
  ) AS avg_subquery
) AS avg_sub;

SELECT
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
  LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS previous_month_count,
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)), 0)) - 100,
    2
  ) AS percentage_change
FROM
  orders o
WHERE
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
GROUP BY
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp);
